settings.editor: By choosing the Innovive IVC System, you're not only reducing energy consumption and water use but also reinforcing your commitment to sustainability—helping to create a greener, more efficient future for your facility.

settings.title: Environmental Benefits of the Innovive IVC System

settings.editor: Stowers Institute for Medical Research 12,000 Cage Capacity. More than 96,000 cage changes.
The Innovive IVC System eliminates cage washing, reducing water use and detergent costs.
With a lower HVAC load compared to traditional cage-wash rooms, our system reduces energy consumption, cutting HVAC-related costs by over 50%.
From clean cage to clean cage, up to 70% reduction in carbon footprint compared to washing.

settings.title: Built on Purpose, Driven by Vision

icon_list.text: We prioritize the use of reclaimed plastic in the manufacturing of our products.

We prioritize partnerships with companies that integrate sustainable practices, such as harnessing solar power to minimize energy consumption. We employ advanced technologies in manufacturing that are designed to be energy-efficient.
Our irradiation process maximizes energy efficiency with optimized cycle loads and both gamma and e-beam methods.
Our lightweight design reduces transportation weight, lowering emissions.
We work with partners to reduce travel distance, maximize load efficiency, and use backhaul routes
We support sustainability by leveraging rail transport and shared shipping containers.

settings.title: Closed-Loop Recycling and Zero Landfill Impact

icon_list.text: Our products are made from clear PET plastic, free of contaminants for easy recycling.
